title: Check: exam day
description: Five questions on the rules and the environment.

questions.prompt: How long is the CKA exam?
questions.explanation: It was three hours historically. Courses recorded before the change still say so - the current exam is two.

questions.prompt: What documentation may you use during the exam?

options.text: The official Kubernetes documentation, in one extra browser tab

questions.explanation: kubernetes.io docs, blog and GitHub. Practise finding pages quickly - searching badly costs minutes you do not have.

questions.prompt: Each task starts by giving you a cluster context. Why does it matter?

options.text: Correct work in the wrong cluster scores nothing

questions.explanation: Run the given `kubectl config use-context` command first, every single time.

questions.prompt: What is the highest-value thing to do in the first minute?

options.text: Set up an alias and autocompletion

questions.explanation: `alias k=kubectl` plus completion pays for itself many times over in a two-hour terminal exam.

questions.prompt: You are stuck on a heavily weighted task with plenty of questions left. What is the right move?

options.text: Flag it, move on, and come back with whatever time remains

questions.explanation: Marks are per task. Time spent stuck is marks not collected elsewhere.
